description: This file defines the IGrainReferenceRuntime interface in the Orleans.Runtime namespace, specifying methods for invoking grain methods asynchronously and synchronously, as well as casting grains to interfaces.

methods.name: InvokeMethodAsync
methods.description: Invokes an asynchronous method on a grain, returning a ValueTask with the result.

methods.name: InvokeMethodAsync
methods.description: Invokes an asynchronous method on a grain without returning a result.

methods.name: InvokeMethod
methods.description: Invokes a void method on a grain without waiting for a response.

methods.name: Cast
methods.description: Converts a grain to a specified interface type.
